repo_context: No skyline layer exists. Walls are 2.4-tall box meshes against sky_night.png (2048x1024 panorama, energy 0.55, fog_sky_affect 0.35). Props are transparent Sprite3D via _prop_sprite, FIXED_Y, base at feet, h world units. Suggested h about 5-7 so the belfry clears the walls. Filename not specified in art_needs; used prop_belltower to match prop_bell / prop_lamppost.

variants.v1: prop_belltower_v1_parish.png — 442x1024 RGBA. Square granite parish tower, arched belfry, unlit bell, shallow pyramidal roof, small iron cross. One regen to put it on green.
variants.v2: prop_belltower_v2_harbour_watch.png — 262x1024 RGBA. Taller thinner harbour watch tower, mixed granite and brick, open unlit cupola, first take kept.
